methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched directly and re-verified for each vendor on 2026-06-15: simplepractice.com/pricing, jane.app/pricing, ensorahealth.com/pricing/theranest-mental-health, therapynotes.com/pricing (title-only on direct fetch; prices corroborated via official TherapyNotes support pricing article and multiple secondary sources), practicebetter.io/pricing, tebra.com/pricing, intakeq.com/pricing, zandahealth.com/pricing, and sessionshealth.com/pricing. Jane App publishes prices exclusively in CAD; monthlyUsd is null for all Jane plans. Tebra publishes no monthly prices (all packages quote-only) so monthlyUsd is null. Compliance claims (HIPAA/BAA/SOC2/GDPR) are set true ONLY where stated on a vendor-owned page or in a direct vendor statement; otherwise null. Notable correction this pass: Sessions Health SOC2 reverted to null (no vendor statement found; Drata trust center link unreachable), and SimplePractice Essential annual discount normalized to the vendor's uniform '2 months free' structure. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: SimplePractice
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified on simplepractice.com/pricing 2026-06-15 (Starter $49, Essential $79, Plus $99 monthly). Group-practice additional-clinician rates ($74 for 2-5, $72 for 6-15, $69 for 16+) corroborated via SimplePractice support compare-plans page. HIPAA/HITRUST/PCI and BAA (/baa/) confirmed on SimplePractice site footer.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Solo practice plan. 2 months free with annual billing (~16.67% off). Does not support adding a second clinician. 30-day free trial, no credit card.

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Solo practice plan with expanded features. 2 months free with annual billing (~16.67% off). Does not support adding a second clinician.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Supports group practices. Additional clinicians: $74/mo each for 2-5 clinicians, $72/mo for 6-15, $69/mo for 16+. 2 months free with annual billing.

limits: Starter and Essential plans limited to 1 clinician
Group practices require Plus plan at minimum
Electronic claims $0.25 per claim on all plans
Care Aide add-on $29.50/mo (owner) + $24.50/mo per additional clinician
enrichment.provenance: Pricing and feature details re-verified on simplepractice.com/pricing; annual discount derived from vendor-stated '2 months free' structure (16.67%) applied uniformly across all three plans.

vendors.name: Jane App
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified on jane.app/pricing 2026-06-15 (Balance CAD $54, Practice CAD $79, Thrive CAD $99); CAD only, monthlyUsd null. HIPAA + BAA confirmed via jane.app/guide/is-jane-hipaa-compliant; SOC 2-Audited and GDPR/PIPEDA confirmed on jane.app/security and pricing page.

plans.name: Balance
plans.notes: CAD $54/month. Single practitioner, up to 20 appointments/month. Telehealth, AI Scribe (5 free notes). USD price not officially published.

plans.name: Practice
plans.notes: CAD $79/month base (1 full-time practitioner). Unlimited appointments, unlimited staff profiles, free SMS reminders. Additional full-time or part-time practitioners available as add-ons. USD price not officially published.

plans.name: Thrive
plans.notes: CAD $99/month base (1 full-time practitioner). Adds rooms & equipment management, patient self check-in, packages & memberships, ratings/reviews. USD price not officially published.

limits: No free trial — demo account available
Prices in CAD only; USD conversion applies for US practices
Insurance billing add-on CAD $20/mo + CAD $5/full-time practitioner
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from jane.app/pricing (CAD only); HIPAA + BAA from jane.app/guide/is-jane-hipaa-compliant; SOC 2-Audited and GDPR/PIPEDA from jane.app/security and pricing page.

vendors.name: TheraNest (Ensora Mental Health)
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified on ensorahealth.com/pricing/theranest-mental-health 2026-06-15 (Essentials $29, Advanced $59, Premier $89 monthly per therapist; annual $319/$649/$979). HITRUST e1 certification and HIPAA confirmed on Ensora product pages; BAA coverage stated by vendor.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Per therapist/month. Annual price $27/therapist/month ($319/yr, equivalent to 1 month free). Includes scheduling, secure portal, calendar sync, basic intake forms, AI notes. Telehealth add-on $12/mo.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Per therapist/month. Annual price $54/therapist/month ($649/yr). Adds online booking, custom forms, group reports, 30 free monthly claims/eligibility checks/reminders. Telehealth add-on $12/mo.

plans.name: Premier
plans.notes: Per therapist/month. Annual price $82/therapist/month ($979/yr). Adds insurance automation, Wiley planner, unlimited telehealth/claims/eligibility/reminders. Annual AMA CPT license $19.50/therapist billed in December.

limits: Telehealth is an add-on ($12/mo) on Essentials and Advanced tiers
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from ensorahealth.com/pricing/theranest-mental-health; HITRUST e1 + HIPAA + BAA coverage confirmed via Ensora product/why-us pages and vendor statements.

vendors.name: TherapyNotes
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified 2026-06-15 via official TherapyNotes support pricing article and multiple corroborating sources (therapynotes.com/pricing returned title-only on direct fetch). Solo $69, Group $79 first + $50/additional clinician, Enterprise same rates w/ 30-user minimum. BAA confirmed via dedicated support BAA article.

plans.name: Solo
plans.notes: Single clinician. No long-term contract. Includes EHR, scheduling, billing, telehealth, client portal, secure messaging. 30-day free trial, no credit card required.

plans.name: Group
plans.notes: $79/mo for first clinician, $50/mo per additional clinician. Unlimited non-clinical staff (admins, schedulers, billers) at no extra cost.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Same per-clinician rates as Group ($79 first + $50 each additional). Requires minimum 30 users. Includes dedicated account manager.

limits: Electronic claims $0.14 per claim, $0.14 per ERA, $0.14 per SMS reminder
keyFeatures: TherapyFuel AI Scribe (HITRUST AI Security Certified)
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from official TherapyNotes support pricing article (primary; pricing page title-only on fetch) corroborated by multiple 2026 sources; BAA confirmed from dedicated support article.

vendors.name: Practice Better
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified on practicebetter.io/pricing 2026-06-15 (Sprout $0, Starter $35, Professional $69, Plus $99, Team $155 monthly; annual $25/$59/$89/$145). HIPAA + GDPR badges shown on pricing page; SOC2 and BAA not stated on public pages.

plans.name: Sprout
plans.notes: Forever free. Up to 3 clients, 1 practitioner. Basic features. For students and recent graduates.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Annual price $25/month (saves $120/year). Up to 10 clients, 1 practitioner license, 1 GB storage. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Annual price $59/month (saves $84/year). Up to 300 clients, 1 practitioner license, 5 GB storage. Adds group scheduling, PDF branding, Zapier. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Annual price $89/month (saves $120/year). Unlimited clients, 1 practitioner + 3 admin licenses, unlimited storage. Adds evergreen programs, portal branding, 750 SMS/month, dedicated fax. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Annual price $145/month. Includes 2 practitioner licenses; additional practitioners $50/month each (up to 200). Unlimited admins/clients/storage. Adds custom roles, team scheduling, advanced workflows, managed billing. Free migration ($500 value). 30-day free trial.

limits: AI Charting Assistant: $0.60/hour after 600 free minutes
enrichment.provenance: All pricing re-verified on practicebetter.io/pricing; HIPAA and GDPR stated on pricing page; SOC2 and BAA not confirmable from publicly accessible pages -> null.

vendors.name: Tebra (formerly Kareo)
vendors.provenance: Pricing page re-verified on tebra.com/pricing 2026-06-15. No monthly prices published; Tebra states pricing varies by providers/features/implementation. All five packages are quote-only.

plans.name: EHR Starter
plans.notes: Certified EHR technology. Quote-only. Priced per clinical provider; non-clinical staff seats included at no extra cost. Low-volume discount for practices billing 100 or fewer claims/month.

plans.name: Billing Starter
plans.notes: Billing-only module. Quote-only.

plans.name: Patient Experience + Marketing
plans.notes: Patient engagement and marketing tools module. Quote-only.

plans.name: EHR+
plans.notes: Enhanced EHR tier (marked 'top choice'). Quote-only.

plans.name: Practice Automation
plans.notes: All-in-one platform (marked 'Best deal'). Quote-only.

limits: All pricing is quote-only; no self-serve signup
keyFeatures: Low-volume billing discount for small practices
Modular: buy only the components needed
enrichment.provenance: Pricing page at tebra.com/pricing confirmed all five packages are quote-only with no published prices; no HIPAA/BAA statement present on the pricing page -> compliance null.

vendors.name: IntakeQ
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified on intakeq.com/pricing 2026-06-15 ($29.90/$54.90/$59.90/$84.90). HIPAA BAA included on all plans confirmed on the pricing page.

plans.name: Forms Only (Low Volume)
plans.notes: Limit of 10 form submissions/month. HIPAA BAA included. Additional practitioners $10/month each. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Forms Only
plans.notes: Unlimited forms, branded custom forms, e-signatures, treatment notes, secure document sharing, e-faxing, HIPAA BAA. 2 assistant accounts included. Additional practitioners $20/month each. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Practice Management (Low Volume)
plans.notes: Limit of 25 appointments + 25 form submissions per 30-day period per practitioner. All Practice Management features. HIPAA BAA included. Additional practitioners $25/month each. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Practice Management
plans.notes: All Forms Only features plus appointment management, reminders, booking widget, automated intake, secure client portal, payments/invoices, recurring payments, claims & superbills, task management, telehealth, phone support. HIPAA BAA included. Additional practitioners $30/month each. 14-day free trial.

limits: Low-volume tier capped at 10 form submissions OR 25 appointments/month
Additional practitioner seats charged per user
enrichment.provenance: Pricing re-verified directly on intakeq.com/pricing; HIPAA BAA included on all plans confirmed on the pricing page. GDPR not stated -> null.

vendors.name: Zanda (formerly Power Diary)
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified on zandahealth.com/pricing 2026-06-15 (Starter $19, Growth $49; +$19/additional practitioner). HIPAA audit completion + ISO 27001 certification confirmed via Zanda blog (Prescient Security audit); BAA not explicitly stated on public pages.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Solo practitioners only. 1 user account, unlimited clients, 100 GB file storage, 1,000 appointments/month limit. Includes intake forms, progress notes, integrated billing, client booking portal, telehealth, appointment reminders. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Base price includes 1 practitioner. Additional practitioners $19/month each. Unlimited appointments, unlimited users, unlimited file storage. Adds advanced waitlist, customizable note templates, multiple locations, room/resource management, bulk communication, comprehensive reports. 14-day free trial.

limits: Telehealth Pro $9/month/practitioner for unlimited video (free tier: 100 min/month)
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from zandahealth.com/pricing; HIPAA audit completion + ISO 27001 + independent GDPR analysis confirmed via Zanda blog post; BAA not explicitly stated -> null.

vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified on sessionshealth.com/pricing 2026-06-15 (Freemium $0, Professional $39 first + $29/additional practitioner). HIPAA confirmed on pricing/features pages; BAA confirmed via support.sessionshealth.com BAA article. SOC2 NOT stated by vendor on any reachable page (Drata trust center unreachable) -> soc2 null.

plans.name: Freemium
plans.notes: Forever free. Up to 3 active clients, 1 practitioner. Core EHR with scheduling, documentation, client portal, billing tools, unlimited storage.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: $39/month for first practitioner, $29/month each additional. Unlimited clients, unlimited administrators at no cost. All Freemium features. 30-day free trial, no credit card required.

keyFeatures: Auto-scored outcome assessments with visual graphs
